description: The filter need not name _id — this one matches on name — and the replacement may carry the matched document's own _id.That _id is not a second way to pick the document: the filter always picks, and the _id is an assertion that it found the one you meant. Say you mean document 7 but typo the filter so it matches document 8 — with the _id present that is an error and nothing is written; leave it out and document 8 is overwritten silently. This case is the agreeing half, where filter and _id name the same document and the replace proceeds. The mismatching half is an error, which this fixture format cannot express; see replace_test.go's ErrImmutableID cases.
